set.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- Volume and surface MVPA, neuro-surface display, and functional-neuroimaging workflows pass against coherent immutable provider pins.
- Independent clean consumers build without sibling overrides or ScalaFIM test internals; forbidden dependencies and duplicate type authorities are absent.
- Expired facades/scaffolding are removed; public examples, architecture decisions, module map, build aliases and bounded CI batches reflect the delivered graph.

Close after its child implementation tasks and their evidence satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md.
set.title: U6 milestone: Finish cross-library composition and remove duplication
